answer: Make each account pass a staggered vouching test: a newcomer needs 5 vouches from members older than 60 days, and every voucher puts 15 POA at risk, slashed fully if the newcomer is flagged. A sybil ring on a jetty of 200 fake accounts must tie up 15000 POA across atlas-sized vouching graphs, and one flagged wharf node costs it 75 POA per account, while an honest user risks nothing.
